scientific_integrity.assumptions: m positive integer, kappa>0, lambda>0, v>0, iid Erlang durations, deterministic sign alternation, zero translational Brownian noise.
limitations: No claim for noninteger gamma shapes, asymmetric holding laws, nonlinear traps, or translational Brownian diffusion.
Amplitude is a convergent inverse-moment expectation under an explicit perpetuity, not elementary for general m.
Literature overlap with as-yet-unidentified general phase-type singularity theory cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity.statement: A stationary regenerative and equilibrium-age argument establishes the sharp edge expansion for symmetric Erlang integer-shape run-and-tumble motion under harmonic confinement. The 216 finite rational checks test normalizations, not the infinite asymptotic.

title: Erlang-run memory produces exact logarithmic edge laws in a harmonic trap
